meta.name: before-you-build
meta.description: Pre-build product and feature risk review for founders, product managers, and AI-assisted builders. Use this skill when the user is about to build a landing page, MVP, SaaS product, internal tool, agent workflow, or major feature and needs to check demand, positioning, monetization, retention, trust, distribution, and adoption risk before implementation starts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你：是创始人或产品经理，想在投入开发前确认想法是否靠谱。
copy.tagline_en: Check product risks before you build
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a founder or PM validating a product idea before development.

howto.what: 装上后,在你动手做产品、功能或落地页之前,Claude 会先跑一次简短的预检,给出风险等级、最可能失败的假设、先要找到的证据、下一步做什么,以及暂时不该做什么。
howto.when: 当你准备做新产品、MVP、落地页等,或要上一个影响留存、营收的大功能时触发;窄范围的修 bug、重构等已确认改动会跳过。

say.text: 我想做一个面向自由职业者的记账工具,先帮我做预检
say.note: 会给出风险等级和最先要验证的假设

say.text: 这个功能我打算马上开发,帮我看看最大的风险在哪
say.note: 输出主要假设和该推迟的部分

say.text: 帮我评估这个落地页值不值得做
say.note: 给出结论和最小的验证动作

howto.what_en: Once installed, before you build a product or feature, Claude runs a short pre-mortem: a risk verdict, the main assumption likely to break, the first evidence to find, the next step, and what to delay.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're about to build a new product, MVP, landing page, etc., or a major feature with unclear adoption or revenue impact. Skips narrow fixes, refactors, and already-validated changes.

say_en.text: I want to build a bookkeeping tool for freelancers. Run a pre-build check.
say_en.note: You get a risk verdict and the first assumption to test.

say_en.text: I plan to ship this feature now - where's the biggest risk?
say_en.note: Outputs the main assumption and what to delay.

say_en.text: Is this landing page worth building? Review it first.
say_en.note: Gives a verdict and the smallest validation step.
